Replace.Text: Why do you continue to waste my time with this nonsense? Begone!
Did you not hear me the first time? Go away!
I'm sorry, are you hard of hearing? The answer will always be no!
I will not field such requests at this time. Please stop asking.
We've been over this before. I will not tell you of my affairs.
The answer remains no. We shall not provide diplomatic details at this time.
We would never share our diplomatic secrets with villains like you!
Do you honestly think I would tell a criminal like you my foreign policy?
Why would you waste your time asking about my foreign affairs? They are none of your business!
I'm sorry, but we prefer to keep our diplomatic secrets safe. Try again some other time.
My advisors deem it important to keep our foreign policy private. Maybe some other time?
We're not comfortable broadcasting our foreign affairs at this time. Perhaps another time?
{1_PlayerName:textkey} is a true friend and can be trusted. (Friendly)
I'm quite fond of {1_PlayerName:textkey} and look forward to our continued friendship. (Friendly)
{1_PlayerName:textkey} and I have been on good terms, and I see no reason why that would change. (Friendly)
I really don't have an opinion of {1_PlayerName:textkey}. (Neutral)
{1_PlayerName:textkey} is neither an enemy of mine nor my friend. (Neutral)
{1_PlayerName:textkey} doesn't bother me at all. (Neutral)
I'll be honest. I don't trust {1_PlayerName:textkey} one bit. (Guarded)
{1_PlayerName:textkey} has alarmed my advisors and we are monitoring the situation. (Guarded)
We're keeping an eye on {1_PlayerName:textkey} due to recent incidents. (Guarded)
{1_PlayerName:textkey}'s rule taints this earth and I would see no problem with it ending. (Hostile)
{1_PlayerName:textkey} is a tyrant and a villain that needs to be taken care of. (Hostile)
Don't remind me that {1_PlayerName:textkey} still walks this earth... (Hostile)
I look up to {1_PlayerName:textkey} with great envy! (Afraid)
I marvel at {1_PlayerName:textkey}'s success. (Afraid)
Hopefully one day I can be as good a leader as {1_PlayerName:textkey}. (Afraid)
{1_PlayerName:textkey} and I are at war! ([COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]AT WAR![ENDCOLOR])
{1_PlayerName:textkey} and I are locked in combat. ([COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]AT WAR![ENDCOLOR])
I am currently settling a dispute with {1_PlayerName:textkey}. ([COLOR_NEGATIVE_TEXT]AT WAR![ENDCOLOR])
I trust you enough to confess that I am planning war against {1_PlayerName:textkey}. (Planning War!)
Don't be fooled by outward appearances. I plan to rid this earth of {1_PlayerName:textkey}. (Planning War!)
I'm sick of {1_PlayerName:textkey}'s presence and I plan on eliminating them soon. (Planning War!)
It may appear that I am friendly with {1_PlayerName:textkey} but that's all show. (Deceptive)
Think you can keep a secret? I plan on deceiving {1_PlayerName:textkey} at earliest convenience. (Deceptive)
I tell the world that {1_PlayerName:textkey} is a friend. I tell you in strictest confidence that that is not the case. (Deceptive)
Times seem hard in your lands, my friend. I hope this gift lightens your burden.
Friends should not have to ask for help. Take this, with my compliments.
We have more than we need, and you seem to have less. Consider this a gift between friends.
Of course. What are friends for?
Take it, and may it serve your people well.
Gladly. I trust you would do the same for me.
I value our friendship, but I cannot give you that.
That is more than my people can spare. I am afraid I must refuse.
We remain friends, and that will not change. But my answer is no.
You asked me for help only recently, my friend. Give it some time before asking again.
Your last request was not so long ago. I cannot consider another one yet.
Not so soon, friend. Come back to me later and we will see.
I'm sorry, but we haven't known you long enough to divulge our diplomatic secrets. Maybe in the future?
We haven't known each other long enough for me to reveal my foreign policy. The answer is no.
I only give away my foreign policy to those whom I trust. I cannot trust someone I've just met.
You again. What more do you want from us?
Our overlord graces us with a visit. What will you take from us this time?
We bow because we must, not because we wish to. Say what you came to say.
Welcome, master, to my lands. How may I be of service?
Greetings! I hope you're pleased to know our workers are hard at work producing resources for your use.
Ah, welcome master! What assistance do you seek from us?
We are done serving you. Release us now, or we will take our freedom by force.
Our people will no longer bow to you. Let us go in peace, or meet us on the battlefield.
Your rule over us ends today. How it ends is up to you.
The time has come for my people to seek their own path in this world. We desire an independent nation. What say you?
Your occupation of our empire is no longer tolerable among my subjects and I am issuing a formal request that you allow my people to live as an individual sovereign state.
We believe the time has come to terminate our Vassalage agreement. Our people desire independent rule. Will you accept this?
You have my thanks. My people will not forget this day.
A wise and generous choice. Let us part as friends.
Our nation is its own master once more. We are grateful for your understanding.
So be it. We will win our freedom on the battlefield.
You would keep us in chains? Then our armies will break them.
If our liberty must be paid for in blood, my people are ready to pay.
Very well. Your people are free to go their own way.
You have served us well. Your request is granted, and you are no longer our vassal.
So be it. Our agreement ends here. Go in peace.
Leave us? I think not. If you want your freedom, you will have to fight for it.
Ungrateful wretch. You will learn what happens to vassals who forget their place.
Independence? You will have war instead, and you will lose.
We placed ourselves under your protection, and this is how you repay us?
You swore to defend us, and now you march against us. The world will hear of this treachery.
Our former protector turns on us. We will fight you with every last breath.
Ah, my vassal. Have you come to grovel, or only to waste my time?
Remember whose protection keeps your people alive. Now, what do you want?
You serve at my pleasure. Speak quickly.
Welcome, loyal vassal. What brings you to my court today?
Greetings. I trust all is well in your lands. What do you need of us?
Rest easy. While you serve us, no one will dare threaten your people. What would you like to discuss?
Very well. My troops will pull back from your border.
I meant no threat. My soldiers will withdraw at once.
As you wish. You will not find my forces near your cities.
There is no cause for alarm. My troops are only passing through.
Those soldiers are on maneuvers, nothing more. You have nothing to fear from me.
Rest assured, I have no quarrel with you. My armies have business elsewhere.
As much as your soulless existence would be worth ending, my men do not wish to attack you at the moment. Consider yourself lucky.
Although it would be my pleasure to kill you, now is not the time for that.
No, my men aren't going to waste their time with you, yet. Your fear amuses me, however.
Move my troops? They are exactly where I want them. Your lands will soon be mine.
This whole world will be mine, and your cities are next. My armies advance.
Why would I retreat when every nation will soon bow to me? Prepare yourself.
So you have noticed my armies. There is no point pretending any longer. Our friendship was a ruse, and now it is over.
You dare give me orders? My troops are going nowhere, except into your lands.
Your vassals deserve to govern themselves. Perhaps this offer will convince you to set them free.
I would like to see your subject nations released. Is this a fair price for their freedom?
Let your vassals go, and this is yours. What do you say?
You have given my people their freedom. We will not forget this kindness.
Few rulers would give up such power willingly. You have our deepest gratitude.
Our nation stands on its own again, thanks to you. May we always meet as friends.
Your loyal service has not gone unnoticed. As a reward, we release you from vassalage.
Your time as our vassal is over. Go forward as a free nation, and remember us kindly.
Our arrangement has run its course. From this day on you rule yourselves. May your people prosper.
You have raised our taxes. My people will remember who emptied their purses.
Higher taxes? Our merchants already struggle. This will not help relations between us.
Is our obedience not enough for you? Now you want more of our gold as well.
Protecting your lands does not come cheap. We have raised your taxes accordingly.
Lower taxes? My people thank you. This bodes well for both our nations.
Your generosity is appreciated. Our economy will be stronger for it, and so will yours.
We are grateful for this relief. It will not be forgotten.
We find we need less of your gold than before, so we have lowered your taxes. Consider it a sign of our goodwill.
We cannot stand alone in this world. Will you take us under your protection?
Your strength is beyond question, and ours is not. We offer you our loyalty in exchange for your protection.
